_comment: The API only ever gives cycle CODES (1C, 25, 2F...). The human names live in a
reference table (Table_02) that Samsung resolves inside their own app, and which
the cloud API does not expose. So this mapping has to be filled in by hand, once.
The order below is device.json's dialOrder, which is the order SmartThings itself
lists the courses in -- so it should line up 1:1 with the cycle list in the
SmartThings app and on the machine's own dial/menu.
'guess' is inferred from each cycle's constraints and is NOT authoritative.
Replace 'name' with the real label; set 'confirmed' to true once verified.
